title: HiTOP Manifestation Record
description: Generic flat record schema for HiTOP manifestation exports. It is intentionally not bound to a specific institution, study, module, instrument, or namespace authority.

code.description: Full HiTOP manifestation code in the form <HiTOP>.M-<TT>-<NS>-<SLUG>.

hitop_base_code.description: Stable atomic HiTOP base code without a manifestation suffix.

suffix.description: Manifestation suffix without the HiTOP base code.

namespace_token.description: Fixed-length token identifying the local authority namespace.

namespace_kind.description: Three-letter source kind used for namespace generation, for example ROR, DOI, DNS, SRC, ORC, ARK, or HTP.

namespace_identifier.description: Canonical authority identifier used to derive the namespace token.

preferred_label.description: Preferred local label or source identifier for the manifestation.

hitop_concept_label.description: Label of the mapped HiTOP target concept, when available.

hitop_concept_url.description: Source URL for the mapped HiTOP target concept, when available.

hitop_factor_concepts.description: Higher-level HiTOP factor, spectrum, or hierarchy context from the source.

hitop_spectrum.description: HiTOP spectrum context from the source.

source_segment.description: Source-specific segment, category, or grouping value.

instruction_text.description: Instruction or stem text shown with the manifestation item.

item_text.description: Observed item, symptom, sign, manifestation, or local operationalization text.

inclusion_condition.description: Inclusion, skip, filter, or applicability condition.

response_scale.description: Response scale text or coded scale description.

selection_type.description: Selection behavior, for example single choice or multiple choice.

response_format.description: Response format, for example closed, open, numeric, or structured.

data_type.description: Data type of the recorded response.

scale_type.description: Scale type, for example Likert, ordinal, nominal, continuous, or binary.

value_range.description: Permitted value range or value set summary.

instrument_short.description: Short instrument, source, module, or dataset label.

instrument_name.description: Full instrument, source, module, or dataset name.

citation.description: Citation, provenance note, or source reference.

population_description.description: Population for which the manifestation record was created or observed.

population_setting.description: Setting, context, or environment for the population or source data.

source_row_number.description: One-based row number in the source table, when applicable.

hitop_base_code_resolution.description: Method or source used to resolve the HiTOP base code.

mapping_review_status.description: Review status of semantic mapping decisions.

extension_value.description: Controlled extension value for use-case-specific fields. Extension field names must start with x_.
